title: frequent items first
rule: List important or frequently used menu items first (still grouping related commands).
pass_when: Important or frequently used items are listed first, with related commands still grouped.
fail_when: Frequent items are buried, or first-listing scatters related commands with no grouping.
overview: Important or frequent menu items lead the list while related items stay grouped.
apply_when: Ordering items inside menus that mix frequent and rare commands.
not_when: Strict alphabetical system menus where platform convention forbids reordering.
agent_hint: List frequent items first without breaking related-command grouping.
description: Put important or frequently used menu items first, while still grouping related commands together. Burying frequent items slows everyday work; sorting only by frequency until related items scatter also hurts scanning. Balance frequency with grouping so the top of the menu stays useful without breaking families of commands. Honor platform menus that mandate a fixed alphabetical or system order.
